description: KSO Mussel Farm BRUV (Zenodo 14713926): GoPro looking down at a mat with bait, 910 frames of 640x360; the human boxes are fish and non-fish. Run 2026-10-23, see README.
setting: It comes from a GoPro looking straight down at a black mat with a bait box in the middle, lying on the seabed at 8-18 m depth at a blue-mussel farm on the Swedish west coast. Gobies, flatfish and crabs (shore and swimming crabs, spider crabs, hermit crabs) come to the bait; animals also appear on the algae and sand around the mat. The photo is small, so a goby is only a few dozen pixels long. Small pale snails (about 2-3 cm) that crawl on the mat get no box, and neither do curled pieces of algae lying on the mat or at its edges.
